It can also refer to approaching wisdom, knowledge, or understanding through continuous study and learning.

In the Quran, this concept is encapsulated by the verse "Allah loves those who turn to Him constantly" (Quran 2:222), which encourages believers to maintain a close relationship with their Creator. By embodying the characteristics of purity, humility, and faithfulness, a person can approach a deeper, more intimate connection with Allah. Additionally, the name can reflect the idea of being near to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) and thereby drawing inspiration and guidance from his teachings and example.
